Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Multi-SWE-RL · dataset size: The Multi-SWE paper describes an initial Multi-SWE-RL release of 4,723 issue-resolving instances from 76 repositories across seven programming languages, each accompanied by a containerized execution environment.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.multi-swe-rl.initial-units.v2

  • The count is the paper’s initial release scope, not a current recount of every later dated card batch or the 1,632-instance benchmark.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Multi-SWE-RL · derived from: The pinned Multi-SWE-RL card describes its initial dated batch as combining new unannotated RL data with instances discarded from Multi-SWE-bench.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.multi-swe-rl.stream-origins.v2

  • The two origins remain distinct within one RL-data family; a discarded benchmark instance is not silently relabeled as manually verified benchmark material.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Multi-SWE-RL · has stage: The Multi-SWE paper states that the initial RL dataset uses the benchmark construction pipeline while excluding the manual-verification phase described for Multi-SWE-bench.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.multi-swe-rl.verification-boundary.v2

  • Automatic environment/test filtering is not equivalent to the benchmark’s dual-human verification, internal QA or expert-annotation counts.
  • No named supplier contribution, human label coverage or universal reward correctness is inferred.
